items.text: Fixed frog animation glitches, sideways skating, and movement speed issues.
Added drinking water need for livestock, allowing them to drink from containers or natural water sources.
Increased swamp tree wood harvest from 300 to 1000 per tree.
Added restoreHierarchy flag to pooled vehicles to fix UI pooling issues.

Improved car handling: prevented duck toggle handbrake lock, applied raw tyre force regardless of handbrake, fixed handbrake logic for non‑car vehicles, and refined suspension, steering, and grip; rear wheels now lock visually during handbrake.
Displayed health bar when hitting monument blockers.
Fixed store prop drawer failing to draw by adding fallback image path.
Prevented null reference crash in FadeCanvasGroup.
Enabled hotbar swapping of overstacks by moving RPC server‑side.
Fixed repair bench functionality.
Corrected cached skin ID handling for random skin crafting.
Fixed arrow revamp icon display issues.
Prevented building volumes from being baked into the navmesh.
Fixed navmesh generation errors and optimized NPC path following.
Potential null reference fix for mannequins.
Added SAM site buffs against drones: proximity fuse missiles, 2.25× speed lead without aim error, and mid‑air destruction of drone‑dropped explosives.
Buffed unused pies: doubled bonus durations for bigcat, hunters, pork, fish, and chicken; increased hunters pie bleed reduction to 90%.
Medkit now reduces radiation by 20, boat planner tech cost reduced to 30, and longsword swing radius increased to 0.4 with reduced swing delay.
Optimized path following for steering agents: only pull path start, re-pull on thresholds, extend paths when chasing moving targets, skip corridor checks when tiles unchanged.
Oil rig puzzles now preserve crate state across server restarts, prevent despawning, force‑reset only when no players nearby, and save progress on locked crates.
Added configurable drone detonation distance.
Applied movement‑speed‑scaled aim sway for passenger‑seat weapons in the attack helicopter.
Introduced a frog “interested” state that seeks shallow water and croaks.
Homing launcher UI now shows “Keep on target” text and lock‑on timer reduced by 30%.
Updated ammo models to display remaining rounds and added chain connector model for python pick cases.
Random skin crafting now includes the default skin in its pool.
Tax collector upkeep now scales with number of authorized players: first 4 add 0%, next 6 add 2% each, further players add 4% each; de‑auth removal delayed 24 h.
New ammo model indicators show remaining rounds and Russian roulette mode assets are now available.
Tax collector upkeep now scales dynamically with the number of online players, using tiered percentage increases.

Various balance tweaks: pies have doubled bonus durations and hunters pie bleed reduction increased to 90%; medkits reduce radiation by 20; Boat Planner tech cost lowered to 30; longsword swing radius increased to 0.4 and swing delay reduced to 1.5; swamp trees yield up to 1000 wood.
Frog behavior improved: animations now play correctly, they seek shallow water, start croaking, and have corrected movement speed.
Livestock can now drink water from nearby containers, rivers, or lakes, satisfying a new water need.
Navmesh issues fixed: building volumes no longer corrupt the navmesh and generation now succeeds in previously invalid areas, improving NPC pathfinding.
Path‑following performance doubled with new optimizations and benchmarking instrumentation.
Fixed a rare crash caused by a null reference in mannequin entities.

Vehicle handling overhauled: handbrake toggle‑duck no longer sticks, raw tyre force applied, suspension, steering and grip tuned, engine revs use front wheel speed, and rear wheels lock visually during handbrake.
Poolable vehicles now include a restoreHierarchy field to prevent UI pooling side‑effects.
Drone detonation distance is now configurable, and aim sway scales with movement speed when using passenger‑seat weapons in the attack helicopter.

UI stability and store usability improved: fallback images for missing props, DynamicResourceRef support for easier resource assignment, hotbar swapping works with overstacks, FadeCanvasGroup null‑reference guarded, and Arrow Revamp icons display correctly.

2026-08-24.summary:
### Gameplay & Balance
- New ammo model indicators show remaining rounds and Russian roulette mode assets are now available.
- Tax collector upkeep now scales dynamically with the number of online players, using tiered percentage increases.
- Various balance tweaks: pies have doubled bonus durations and hunters pie bleed reduction increased to 90%; medkits reduce radiation by 20; Boat Planner tech cost lowered to 30; longsword swing radius increased to 0.4 and swing delay reduced to 1.5; swamp trees yield up to 1000 wood.

### Animals
- Frog behavior improved: animations now play correctly, they seek shallow water, start croaking, and have corrected movement speed.
- Livestock can now drink water from nearby containers, rivers, or lakes, satisfying a new water need.

### NPC & AI
- Navmesh issues fixed: building volumes no longer corrupt the navmesh and generation now succeeds in previously invalid areas, improving NPC pathfinding.
- Path‑following performance doubled with new optimizations and benchmarking instrumentation.
- Fixed a rare crash caused by a null reference in mannequin entities.

### Vehicles & Drones
- Vehicle handling overhauled: handbrake toggle‑duck no longer sticks, raw tyre force applied, suspension, steering and grip tuned, engine revs use front wheel speed, and rear wheels lock visually during handbrake.
- Poolable vehicles now include a restoreHierarchy field to prevent UI pooling side‑effects.
- Drone detonation distance is now configurable, and aim sway scales with movement speed when using passenger‑seat weapons in the attack helicopter.

### UI & Store
- UI stability and store usability improved: fallback images for missing props, DynamicResourceRef support for easier resource assignment, hotbar swapping works with overstacks, FadeCanvasGroup null‑reference guarded, and Arrow Revamp icons display correctly.

items.text: Fixed heavy scientists getting stuck after being dropped by the helicopter on certain seeds (small oilrig).

Fixed mismatched colliders and off‑center gib origins for multiple deployables (io.table, HotAirBalloon armor, sculpture.ice, mannequin, chandelier, component.box.charcoal.large, HotAirBalloon basket, refinery, windmill, wooden box, fireplace, lift shaft top, tool cupboard, cannon, component box wood), eliminating clipping and improving break‑apart physics.
Added gib pieces to the Frankenstein table so it now breaks apart correctly when destroyed.
Reduced stack sizes for F1 grenades, Bee grenades, Flashbangs, and Molotovs from 5 to 3.

2026-08-22.summary:

- Fixed heavy scientists getting stuck after being dropped by the helicopter on certain seeds (small oilrig).

### Deployable Physics & Collisions
- Fixed mismatched colliders and off‑center gib origins for multiple deployables (io.table, HotAirBalloon armor, sculpture.ice, mannequin, chandelier, component.box.charcoal.large, HotAirBalloon basket, refinery, windmill, wooden box, fireplace, lift shaft top, tool cupboard, cannon, component box wood), eliminating clipping and improving break‑apart physics.
